title: Hedgehog pathway ODE (BIOMD0000000395) perturbed at EC50: fails the Ptc-loss sign check
evidence_kind: SIMULATED: published-model ODE dynamics, not fit to fish data

model.name: libRoadRunner 2.11.0 CVODE, rtol 1e-10, deterministic
model.context: Sivakumar 2011 Drosophila Hedgehog signal-transduction model; Ptc/Smo/Sufu perturbations at EC10/EC50/EC90 Hh doses interpolated from a 37-dose response.

numerical_checks.name: Ptc loss at EC50 (biology: constitutive activation)
Sufu-Ci repressor complex loss at EC50
